name: Tiny Desk AI: Sing Lead at Your Own Office-Desk Concert
blurb: The tiny desk AI trend is the meme where AI puts new faces into a famous office-desk concert: the lead belts a soul song, laughs mid-line, and a surprise sax player takes the solo.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
A viral office-desk concert: a five-piece soul band plays an upbeat funk song, crowded around a wooden desk, and the person in [Image 1] sings lead. Vertical 9:16, photorealistic, like a real live session filmed in an office: a slightly handheld camera, warm and cozy color.

WHO IS WHO: the LEAD SINGER is the person in [Image 1], in every shot. Each one has the exact face from their own image (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), and the hair and the clothes from it (any logo, team name or print stays plain). Never blend or swap their faces. Each face stays the same from the first frame to the last, also while singing with the mouth wide open and while laughing, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph. An animal in an image stays that animal, upright, with its own face and fur. The four bandmates are invented adult strangers, each with their own face, never the face from [Image 1]: a keyboard player seated at the desk with a desk mic, two backup singers standing behind the desk, and a saxophone player at the side with a gold saxophone.

The place: a cramped office corner turned into a tiny concert stage, warm lamps and soft daylight. Behind the band, wooden bookshelves up to the ceiling, packed with vinyl records, old books, small trophies, toys and plants. In front, a worn wooden desk with a red stage keyboard, a few mugs, and microphones on thin black stands. No readable letters anywhere: no sign, no show name, no logo.

0-1.5 s: a medium-wide shot from the front: the lead stands at a microphone in front of the desk, in the middle, eyes closed, singing; behind, the keyboard player plays and the backup singers sway and clap on the beat.
1.5-6.8 s: a close-up of the lead, the face large and sharp: exactly the face from [Image 1]. The lead sings with full feeling, holds one long high note with the mouth wide open, breaks into a huge, happy laugh at 4.5 s, waves one open hand in the air at 5.5 s, then grins and nods along.
6.8-7.8 s: a medium shot of the band behind the lead: the backup singers sway and clap, the keyboard player rocks at the keys.
7.8-10 s: the camera swings to the side: the saxophone player leans into a mic and plays a short, wailing solo, cheeks puffed, while the lead points at them and grins.

Sound: none of its own; a soul-funk song is put on afterwards, so the singing must be easy to see. No music, no voices. The lead sings at full voice from the first frame: clear lip movements in sung phrases, one long held high note with the mouth wide open, then a huge laugh mid-line. The backup singers sing and clap along. During the saxophone solo the lead's mouth is closed or smiling. Exactly five people. No famous people, no children. Plain clothes: no jerseys, no team colors, no logos, no headsets. No captions, no text, no watermark. One head per person, five fingers on each hand, never merge bodies.
